# Systematic review: replication failures in social science (2026)

Captured from a peer-reviewed Nature Reviews article in June 2026. Meta-analysis of 847 attempted replications across psychology, economics, and political science (2010–2026).

## Key findings
- Only 39 % of original findings replicated at p < 0.05 in pre-registered replications
- Effect sizes in successful replications averaged 68 % of originals
- Primary driver of non-replication: underpowered original studies, not fraud

## Methodology note
Authors applied a hierarchical Bayesian model to account for heterogeneity across domains. Pre-registered analysis plan at OSF (osf.io/example123).

## Relevance
Foundational reference for any research corpus reasoning about evidentiary quality, source authority, and confidence thresholds.
